description: White develops both knights before fianchettoing in the Four Knights System, meeting Black's central e5 pawn with flexible piece play. The critical moment comes at move 4, when Black pins the c3-knight with 4...Bb4 instead of striking in the center — White must decide between the d4 break and solid consolidation.

lines.description: After 1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6, White fianchettoes with 4.g3 and Black answers with the testing 4...Bb4, pinning the c3-knight and putting immediate pressure on e4. White develops 5.Bg2 and both sides castle, then Black solidifies with 6...d6. The middlegame revolves around whether White can achieve the d4 break or must accept a slower maneuvering game against the pin.
